# Load dependencies
```{r message=FALSE}
library(scater)
library(ggplot2)
source("notebooks/01_data_collection/lib_sce.R")
```


# Load object containg Cell type atlas
```{r}
x <- loadHDF5SingleCellExperiment("notebooks/01_data_collection/allen_brain_atlas/out/human_m1_10x.h5")
x <- scuttle::logNormCounts(x)
#x$y_true <- paste0(x$class_label,"///",x$subclass_label,"///",x$cluster_label)
x$y_true <- paste0(x$class_label,"///",x$subclass_label)
```




# Display the umap and some markers
```{r eval=FALSE}
ggcells(x) + 
  geom_point(aes(x=TSNE.1,y=TSNE.2,color=class_label),size=1) + 
  coord_equal() +
  theme_classic()
ggcells(x,features = "GAD1") + 
  geom_point(aes(x=TSNE.1,y=TSNE.2,color=GAD1),size=1) + 
  coord_equal() +
  theme_classic()
ggcells(x,features = "NEUROD1") + 
  geom_point(aes(x=TSNE.1,y=TSNE.2,color=NEUROD1),size=1) + 
  coord_equal() +
  theme_classic()
```



#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#
# Extract a balanced taining set from the whole dataset
#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#

```{r}
trn <- x
trn <- trn[,!is.na(trn$y_true)]
set.seed(1234L)
trn <- local({
  trn_cells <- splitAsList(colnames(trn),trn$y_true) |>
    lapply(sample,size=100,replace=TRUE) |>
    unlist() |>
    sample()
  trn[,trn_cells]
})
trn <- local({
  n <- t(rowsum(t(assay(trn)>0)+0,trn$y_true)) # Count number of cell
  trn[rowMaxs(n)>=5]
})
```



#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#
# TRIAL1: Extract global marker genes with PCA
#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#
```{r}
set.seed(3210)
pca <- runPCA(t(logcounts(trn)),rank=10,center = TRUE,scale = FALSE)
pca_markers <- local({
  D <- apply(+pca$rotation,2,rank,ties.method="first")
  U <- apply(-pca$rotation,2,rank,ties.method="first")
  M <- pmin(U,D)<=10
  M <- which(M,arr.ind = TRUE)
  splitAsList(rownames(trn)[M[,1]],colnames(U)[M[,2]])
})
```


#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#
# Check performance of selected marker genes
#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#-#
```{r}
set.seed(54321)
TRN <- trn[unique(unlist(pca_markers))]
TST <- x[rownames(TRN),sample(setdiff(colnames(x),colnames(TRN)))]

rf <- randomForest::randomForest(
  x = as.matrix(t(logcounts(TRN))),
  y = factor(TRN$y_true)
)
TST$rf_pred <- predict(rf,as.matrix(t(logcounts(TST))))
```


```{r}
table(sub("///.*","",TST$y_true),sub("///.*","",TST$rf_pred))
table(TST$y_true,TST$rf_pred)
perf <- tapply(TST$y_true != TST$rf_pred,TST$y_true,mean)
data.frame(type=names(perf),err=unname(perf)) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_col(aes(y=type,x=err),color="black") + 
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + xlab("error rate")
```

```{r}
x <- loadHDF5SingleCellExperiment("notebooks/01_data_collection/allen_brain_atlas/out/human_m1_10x.h5")
#writeHDF5Array(counts(x),"x_assay.h5","/counts")
assay(x,withDimnames=FALSE) <- HDF5Array("x_assay.h5","/counts")
x <- addPerCellQCMetrics(x,BPPARAM=BiocParallel::SerialParam(progressbar = TRUE))
x <- addPerFeatureQCMetrics(x,BPPARAM=BiocParallel::SerialParam(progressbar = TRUE))

sseq <- loadHDF5SingleCellExperiment("notebooks/01_data_collection/allen_brain_atlas/out/human_ctx_sseq.h5")
#writeHDF5Array(counts(sseq),"sseq_assay.h5","/counts")
assay(sseq,withDimnames=FALSE) <- HDF5Array("sseq_assay.h5","/counts")
sseq <- addPerCellQCMetrics(sseq,BPPARAM=BiocParallel::SerialParam(progressbar = TRUE))
sseq <- addPerFeatureQCMetrics(sseq,BPPARAM=BiocParallel::SerialParam(progressbar = TRUE))
sseq <- sseq[rownames(x)]

plot(rowData(x)$mean,rowData(sseq)$mean,log="xy",asp=1,cex=0.3);abline(0,1)

```
